narrative_redacted: I was a designated pepperball launching system operator assigned to a mobile field force reaction team. Our mission was to maintain law and order during the civil unrest that occurred in the northeast part of the city. We responded to the area of [ADDRESS]/[ADDRESS] for the report of a large crowd in the street. When I arrived, I saw a large crowd of approximately two hundred people standing in the middle of the intersection and on both streets. When they saw us exit our cars, many in the mob began throwing rocks and bottles at us. I immediately fired twenty rounds of pepperball at the feet of the mob in the intersection and at the feet of the groups on both sides of the street, who in turn fled the area. All of the rounds impacted where I had aimed, striking the ground, breaking into powder form and turning into clouds of PAVA. The PAVA spread amongst the rioters, who dispersed in all directions. Because of the constant riotous behavior of the mobs on the east side of the city, no photographs or neighborhood checks were conducted. Our reaction team had to move on to address those mobs in a timely manner. No injuries reported.

On 11/04/19 at approximately 1500 hours I responded to [ADDRESS] in a SWAT capacity in order to assist in the safe resolution of a barricaded armed subject. Members of HNT had been attempting to establish communication with (A) for hours prior to my arrival VIA a robot that allows them two way communication. (A) was uncooperative with all attempts to de-escalate the situation through negotiation. Myself and other members of the SWAT team had been tasked with forming an arrest team to covertly enter the apartment and get a view of the subjects bedroom in order to use less lethal tools in order to gain compliance. Ofc [NAME] provided Deadly Physical Force coverage while I transitioned to my Less Lethal Penn Arms GL-1 Compact 40mm Launching Platform. Assisting officers breached the bedroom door and I observed (A) standing alone in the bedroom with [PERSON]s back to me. (A) was wearing a hooded sweatshirt and no pants or underwear. I could not see [PERSON]s hands and it appeared as though [PERSON] was attempting to climb up onto a window sill. I yelled for (A) to show us [PERSON]s hands and to get on the ground however [PERSON] continued to ignore verbal warnings. Ofc [NAME] deployed a CTS Noise Flash Diversion Device into the room and again I yelled for (A) to show [PERSON]s hands and get on the ground. At this point I could still not see (A)'s hands or the knife [PERSON] was said to possess and It appeared to me that (A) was potentially attempting to climb onto the window sill in order to jump out of it in a suicide attempt.

I then yelled "40, 40" in an effort to warn my teammates that i was about to deploy my Less Lethal Platform. At about 1525 hours I fired one foam baton from my launcher. The subject stood about 25 feet away from me and my point of aim was the subject's buttocks. The round impacted the subject in the right side of [PERSON]s buttocks exactly where I had aimed. The subject responded by jumping up and then sitting down on the floor, however [PERSON] continued to ignore verbal commands. I began to reload my launcher in case a follow up shot was necessary as assisting officers moved into the room and took (A) into custody.

Sgt. [NAME] reported the following: At approximately 1525 hours, SWAT personnel and I made entry into the apartment to establish communication with (A). Once [PERSON]s bedroom door was opened, I observed (A) attempting to crawl up onto the window sill near [PERSON]s bed. Another officer utilized a Less Lethal tool at which point (A) sat on the floor, facing officers. At the time, (A) was wearing a thin hoody with no pants or underwear. I could see both of [PERSON]s hands were empty.
